title: Game Awards 2026 Nominees: GTA 6 Leads With 8 Nods
description: The Game Awards 2026 nominees are out: GTA 6 leads with eight nominations, including Game of the Year, ahead of its launch. Full breakdown and voting dates.

body.text: The Game Awards 2026 nominees are out, and Grand Theft Auto 6 tops the list with eight nominations, according to Eurogamer. That is a big result for a game that, per the same report, doesn't launch until two days after the nominations went live. It shows how much weight Rockstar's next release already carries in the industry.
Game Awards 2026 nominees: what GTA 6 is up for
Eurogamer lists GTA 6's nominations across a wide range of categories:

items: Best Performance, for Manni L. Perez as Lucia

body.text: That last nod has a side effect. According to Eurogamer, it is how fans learned who plays Lucia in the first place.
Who GTA 6 is up against for Game of the Year
The Game of the Year category is stacked. Eurogamer says GTA 6 faces 007 First Light, Control Resonant, Phantom Blade Zero, Resident Evil Requiem and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.
It's a mix of big franchises and a closely watched action title, so the top prize is far from a formality.
Which publishers lead, and how a game gets nominated before launch
Nintendo is the most-nominated publisher, with 12 nominations across its games, Eurogamer reports. Capcom follows with 11, while Annapurna Interactive and PlayStation have nine each.

As for how GTA 6 made the shortlist before release, the nominees were chosen by a jury of more than 160 media and creator outlets. Eurogamer notes that these outlets may get advance or pre-release access to games, which explains the timing.
When the winners are revealed and how to vote
The winners will be announced on Thursday, 10th December, at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. Fans can cast their votes on The Game Awards' website until 6pm PT on 9th December.

The show streams for free on more than 40 platforms, including YouTube, Twitch, Prime Video and Steam. Eurogamer says last year's show drew an estimated 171 million livestreams, up 11 percent from 154 million in 2024. For viewers in India, that means no paywall to watch.

What to watch next: GTA 6's launch, which Eurogamer places just two days after the nominations, and how critics and players react once they've actually played it. The fan vote closes on 9th December, and the final results arrive the next day. Whether the most-nominated game also takes the biggest trophy is the question to track.
